dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged outer perimeters of approximately five 'O' and 'C' shaped light-grey patches across the mid-dorsal region, displaying sharp gradient transitions from dark brown perimeters to high-intensity interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid white pixel clusters located on the anterior dorsal flank, with lower density scattering of similar low-gradient blobs along the posterior dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle extending across the upper dorsal surface, with the widest angle located near the center-top of the visible torso.

other_distinctive_markers: A fine-grained, interconnected reticulated network of light-colored lines is visible on the posterior lateral flank, transitioning away from the discrete macro-annuli seen dorsally.
